title: Balance outlined Inputs and normalize wide rewrites over opaque terms
summary: The Lean reconstructor now builds the outlined proof's input conjunction as a balanced tree, so files with over a thousand assertions no longer exhaust Lean's heartbeat budget, and wide theory rewrites may range over opaque terms such as uninterpreted applications, mod, and div, gated on the two sides' canonical atom keys so decided mod bounds still go to grind. Three sample QF_LIA and QF_UFLIA benchmarks that failed in Lean now verify.
